fields.statement: Verifier at 44e2caf9 (attempt 2, fixing finding f1). `go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... -run Request` passes: TestRequestPlanRunArgsPassRef checks planRunArgs passes the ref as the single word --ref=<ref> for https://example.com/issues/7, --dry-run, --change=<id> and -h, and passes no --ref word without a ref. `go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/request-ref` passes, including the run start --workflow plan --new 'Planned' --ref step whose change show --json has "ref": "https://example.com/issues/9". Read cmd/rhiza/argv.go parseGlobals: --ref=... matches no global name and passes through whole. With a scratch build in a scratch repo, `change new A --ref=--dry-run --json` wrote a real change set whose change show --json has "ref": "--dry-run", so the ref is no longer read as a global flag.
